zh.title: B-KWA 波音 737 MAX 9 抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 呼號 HGB710；B-KWA 抵達桃園；營運者未識別
body: 本站監測系統觀測到一架註冊號 B-KWA 的航空器於臺灣桃園國際機場完成抵達。機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground。
該航空器的 ICAO hex 為 789298，註冊號為 B-KWA，呼號為 HGB710。航空器 ICAO 機型為 B39M，機型顯示名稱為 Boeing 737 MAX 9。營運者 ICAO 為 HGB，但營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均為未識別。
首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-10T15:40:11Z，確認抵達時間為 2026-08-10T16:28:54Z。有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable。
事件 ID 為 fw-fe91c683d7ad4cbc，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。統計說明為系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。由於營運者各項欄位均為未識別，本站無法確認該航班的執飛目的、航線或所屬航空公司，僅能就觀測資料本身記錄該架航空器抵達桃園機場一事。
公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，本次觀測僅能確認該架 Boeing 737 MAX 9 航空器於上述時間抵達臺灣桃園國際機場。本站不對該航班的性質（如包機、貨運、客運、調機或維修等）做出任何推測，亦不推斷其起飛機場或後續目的地。

en.title: B-KWA Boeing 737 MAX 9 Arrives at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport
en.summary: Callsign HGB710; B-KWA arrives at RCTP; operator unidentified
body: The site's monitoring system observed an aircraft with registration B-KWA completing an arrival at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The airport ICAO code is RCTP and the airport name is 臺灣桃園國際機場. The arrival determination is confirmed_arrival, with confirmation basis being located within the airport geofence and alt_baro reading ground.

The aircraft ICAO hex is 789298, registration is B-KWA, and callsign is HGB710. The aircraft ICAO type is B39M, with the display model name Boeing 737 MAX 9. The operator ICAO is HGB, but operator IATA, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator country or region are all listed as unidentified.

The first valid observation time is 2026-08-10T15:40:11Z and the confirmed arrival time is 2026-08-10T16:28:54Z. The number of valid observation records is 2. The primary data source is Airplanes.live, the secondary data source is ADSB.lol, and the cross-confirmation status is secondary_unavailable.

The event ID is fw-fe91c683d7ad4cbc and the data type is public ADS-B observation. The statistical note states that the system's observation history is still accumulating and there are no comparable long-term statistics available. Because all operator fields are unidentified, the site cannot confirm the operating purpose, route, or airline for this flight and can only record the arrival of this aircraft at Taoyuan Airport based on the observation data itself.

Public ADS-B observation data shows that this observation can only confirm that the Boeing 737 MAX 9 aircraft arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport at the stated time. The site does not speculate on the nature of the flight, such as charter, cargo, passenger, ferry, or maintenance, nor does it infer the departure airport or subsequent destination.
